title: No test makes a Workout tab save fail
what: On the Workout tab, no test makes a save fail and checks what the member sees. That covers a new folder or routine order, the easy-weeks setting, a folder delete, and the routine list that cannot load (three quiet retries, then 'Couldn't load your routines' with a retry). Every test of these parts only checks saves that work.
expected: At least one test per action makes the save fail and checks the plain message, that the old value stays on screen, and that the list never sticks on a skeleton or shows 'No routines yet' when routines exist.
how_often: whenever the phone refuses a write
fix_line: Add tests that make each Workout tab save fail and check the message and the old value

title: No test checks the widget and reminder while a workout is open
what: No test checks that the home-screen widget says 'Resume' while a workout is open, or that no workout reminder fires that day. No test checks that both go back to normal, and the lock-screen card goes away, once the workout ends. The reminder tests only check days already trained.
expected: A test opens a workout and checks the widget's 'Resume' and that no reminder fires. It then ends the workout and checks the widget, the reminder and the lock-screen card are back to normal, and that correcting a saved workout does not count as open.
fix_line: Add a test for the widget and reminder while a workout is open and after it ends

title: No test covers what goes wrong on the New exercise screen
what: No test checks any problem on the New exercise screen: a name already in the library, a save that fails, a refused camera, a video that is too long or too large. No test checks that changing a photo deletes the old file, or that cancelling a change keeps the old picture. The tests only check forms that save cleanly and the sheets opening.
expected: Tests for each problem check its pop-up words and that Save can be tapped again. A test also checks that replacing a photo leaves one file on the phone.
how_often: each time a member makes or changes their own exercise
fix_line: Add tests for the duplicate name, save error, camera, video limits and photo replacement

title: No test covers Repeat, Edit or a failure on the Profile feed
what: From a Profile feed card's menu, no test checks Repeat (a new workout with the same exercises, and never replacing an open one without asking) or Edit ('Can't edit this one' with the reason). No test checks the words for a workout deleted on another screen, a failed action, or a failed delete.
expected: Tests start Repeat and Edit from a feed card, including with a workout open. They also check 'Couldn’t open this workout. It may have been deleted.', 'That didn’t work' and 'Could not delete this workout. It is still here.'
how_often: each time a member repeats or edits a past workout from Profile
fix_line: Add phone tests for Repeat, Edit and the failure words on the Profile feed

title: No screen test of merging or hiding exercises
what: Merging and hiding exercises are tested only in the database. No test shows the 'Merge into…' picker, the merge question with its workout count, the 'Hide <name>?' question, the 'Hidden exercises' screen or its empty 'Nothing hidden' state. No test shows the plain words when a merge or hide is refused because the exercise is in the running workout or has history.
expected: A phone test merges a duplicate and hides and shows a library exercise. It reads each question, the Hidden exercises screen, and the refusal words.
how_often: each time a member tidies their exercise list
fix_line: Add one phone test for the merge and hide screens and their refusals

title: The import's progress, done counts and replace-with-undo are never shown
what: The Hevy import test on the phone stops at starting the import. No test reads 'Importing <n> / <total>', the done words with 'Workouts added', 'Sets logged' and 'New exercises created', or checks that the counts match History. Re-importing after a date edit, 'Delete <n> workouts first?' and the '<n> workouts replaced' bar with Undo are never shown either.
expected: A phone test reads the progress and done counts and compares them with History. Another replaces workouts, then undoes it.
how_often: each import from Hevy or Strong
fix_line: Add phone checks for the import's counts and the replace-with-undo path

title: A journey and a test still use the removed 'Same folder' choice
what: Settings now offers only 'Any workout' and 'Same routine' for where Previous values come from; 'Same folder' was removed and a saved one reads as Any workout. One journey still starts from 'Same folder', and one database test still checks the 'First time in this folder' line under it. A member cannot reach that path any more.
expected: The journey and the test use a choice a member can pick ('Same routine', whose line is 'First time in this routine'), or the old line and its test are removed.
fix_line: Point the journey and the test at Same routine, or drop the old folder line
